Hi Alex —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. I want to get a 30–45m kickoff on the calendar to walk through vendor setup, PO intake, and the pre-onboarding paperwork so we can turn on Dedicated capacity quickly. Proposed goals for the call:

- Confirm vendor contacts and PO routing (billing & legal)

- Surface any compliance questions (data handling, IP) that would affect Private deployment
